headline: European Stocks Slide as Iseq All-Share Drops 0.73% to Close Week
summary: European stock indices closed lower on Friday, with Ireland's Iseq All-Share falling 0.73%, as broader European equity markets decoupled from temporary rebounds in US tech shares.
why: European stock market indices reflect regional economic sentiment and multinational earnings across the Eurozone.

impacts.name: ISEQ Overall Index
impacts.why: Widespread selling in European shares dragged Irish equity benchmarks lower at the close.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Concerns over regional inflation figures and economic slowing pressured European equity indices.
